title: Matrix change of the pinned normal frame
statement: Given any two NormalFrames N,N′ of the same rank d and separated h, for ordered functions x,x′ [def-pur-diagonal-difference-frame-data], there are inverse matrices M,H over Γ(U,O_U) with dx′_j=Σ_i M_ji dx_i and N′*(v_j)=Σ_i projection*(M_ji) N*(v_i). No affine, smoothness, positive-rank or nonempty-source assumption is added.

source.place: Steps 1–3 and change of frame; detailed proof of lem-pur-diagonal-difference-rees-frame

proof.text: The free sheaf frames induce bases of global differential sections. Set M and H to the transposes of the two basis-transition matrices; the basis matrix identities give both inverse equations. Expand dx′ in the old basis. Positive difference normalization makes the inverse conormal maps agree on every da. Apply the degree-one inclusion and cone counit to that expansion; linearity and compatibility with the structure map give the same matrix on normal coordinates.

theorem frame_change {U V : Scheme.{u}} {d : ℕ} {h : U ⟶ V} [IsSeparated h]
    {x x' : ULift.{u} (Fin d) → Γ(U, ⊤)}
    (N : NormalFrame d h x) (N' : NormalFrame d h x') :
    ∃ M H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Γ(U, ⊤),
      M * H = 1 ∧ H * M = 1 ∧
      (∀ j : Fin d, h.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d (X := op ⊤) (x' (.up j)) =
        ∑ i : Fin d, M j i •
          h.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d (X := op ⊤) (x (.up i))) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin d, N'.normal.hom.appTop (AffineSpace.coord U (.up j)) =
        ∑ i : Fin d,
          (PurityNormalBundle.projection (pullback.diagonal h)).appTop (M j i) *
            N.normal.hom.appTop (AffineSpace.coord U (.up i)))
